title: Optimal Capital Structure for Life Insurance Companies Offering Surplus Participation
abstract: arXiv:2504.12851v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This manuscript develops a dynamic capital structure model of life insurance companies offering participating contracts. Specifically, we explain why life insurers offer guaranteed payments either with or without policyholder surplus participation and derive conditions under which participating features are endogenously preferred. We show that surplus participation helps mitigate the asset substitution effect but is not always optimal. Depending on the tax rate and the recovery rate in bankruptcy, the insurer may optimally choose a non-participating contract.

translated_title: 提供盈余分配的人寿保险公司的最优资本结构
translated_abstract: 本文构建了提供分红合同的人寿保险公司的动态资本结构模型。具体而言，我们解释了人寿保险公司为何提供有或无保单持有人盈余分配的保证支付，并推导出了内生产生分红特征偏好的条件。我们表明，盈余分配有助于缓解资产替代效应，但并不总是最优的。根据税率和破产回收率的不同，保险公司可能会最优地选择非分红合同。
tldr: 本文构建了分红型人寿保险公司的动态资本结构模型，证明盈余分配虽能缓解资产替代效应，但在不同税率和破产回收率条件下并不总是最优选择。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic capital structure model for life insurers offering participating contracts, showing that surplus participation mitigates the asset substitution effect but is not always optimal, depending on tax rates and bankruptcy recovery rates.
